Qualitative Finding: Participants consistently praised the fluency and grammatical quality of AI-revised texts.
Integrated Interpretation: AI-assisted revision substantially improved formal linguistic performance.

Qualitative Finding: Participants reported that their writing sounded less personal and less distinctive.
Integrated Interpretation: Improvements in textual quality coincided with reduced linguistic individuality.

Qualitative Finding: Participants questioned whether the revised texts genuinely represented their own writing.
Integrated Interpretation: Perceived ownership declined despite improvements in writing quality.

Qualitative Finding: Participants described themselves as reviewing or approving AI suggestions rather than independently composing texts.
Integrated Interpretation: AI-assisted revision altered participants' perceived role during the writing process.
